'''Bren Quersey''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
[[File:Red_8_Quersey.jpg|thumb|250px|Bren Quersey flying as Red Eight]]
Born on [[Lantillies/Legends|Lantillies]], Bren Quersey dreamed of attending the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Raithal Academy/Legends|Raithal Academy]], but washed out, instilling in him a desire for vengeance against those who failed to see his worth. As a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Dantooine Squadron]], Quersey was paired with [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], who had trained him on [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]], by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]] in the hope that Antilles' dedication to the Rebellion would calm Quersey's anger.<ref name="TEGW" /><ref name="CCGBQ">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Bren Quersey}}</ref>

In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], he was transferred to [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]], taking the place of veteran [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Jal Te Gniev]]. Flying a [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]] assigned to him by Antilles under the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] [[Red Eight/Legends|Red Eight]], Quersey participated in the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], scoring a hit on [[Black 2|Black Two]] [[Mithel/Legends|"Mauler" Mithel]], but failing to neutralise the [[TIE pilot]],<ref name="ANH" /> before being [[Death/Legends|killed]] in action himself.<ref name="TEGW" /><ref name="CCGR8">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Red 8}}</ref>
